g.text: One row per token of the model's own transcript. Grey = gradient times activation per frame (Grad-CAM without the time pooling, which

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: loses the where). Where the grey mass and the coloured tick agree, the two methods name the same audio. A row smeared across the clip

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: is a token the model wrote from context, not from any one sound.
